verdict.rationale: Bevy exposes a well-documented public Rust API (ECS components/systems, reference docs, examples) that any user—including an AI agent generating code—can use to drive the engine (bevy-docs-14, bevy-docs-20, bevy-docs-27, bevy-docs-42, bevy-docs-43). However, probes show no AI-agent-oriented interface such as llms.txt or an OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (bevy-probe-1, bevy-probe-2, bevy-probe-3), meaning the API is documented for human developers but not explicitly packaged for AI-native consumption. Missing for 10: llms.txt or similar AI-discoverable docs, an OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, and any evidence of agentic tooling built on top of the Rust API.
